## A path for every goal

### [Introduction to Python](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/intro-to-python-for-data-science)

Master the basics of data analysis with Python in just four hours. This online course will introduce the Python interface and explore popular packages.

### [Introduction to SQL](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-sql)

Learn how to create and query relational databases using SQL in just two hours.

### [Introduction to Power BI](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-power-bi)

Master the Power BI basics and learn to use the data visualization software to build impactful reports.

### [Introduction to AI for Work](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-ai-for-work)

Explore what AI is and how to use it responsibly for smarter, more productive work!

### [Introduction to Tableau](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-tableau)

Start your Tableau journey with our Introduction to Tableau course. Discover Tableau basics such as its features and dashboards.

### [Introduction to Excel](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-excel)

Master the Excel basics and learn to use this spreadsheet tool to conduct impactful analysis.

### [Introduction to AI for Work](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/introduction-to-ai-for-work)

Explore what AI is and how to use it responsibly for smarter, more productive work!

### [Working with the OpenAI API](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/working-with-the-openai-api)

Start your journey developing AI-powered applications with the OpenAI API. Learn about the functionality that underpins popular AI applications like ChatGPT.

### [AI Agent Fundamentals](/tracks/ai-agent-fundamentals)

Discover how AI agents can change how you work and deliver value for your organization!

### [Hugging Face Fundamentals](/tracks/hugging-face-fundamentals)

Find the latest open-source AI models, datasets, and apps, build AI agents, and fine-tune LLMs with Hugging Face. Join the biggest AI community today!

### [Understanding Prompt Engineering](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/understanding-prompt-engineering)

Learn how to write effective prompts with ChatGPT to apply in your workflow today.

### [Developing LLM Applications with LangChain](https://www.datacamp.com/courses/developing-llm-applications-with-langchain)

Discover how to build AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompts, chains, and agents in LangChain.

### [Data Analyst in Python](/tracks/data-analyst-with-python)

Develop your data analytics skills in Python. Gain the data analyst skills to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data. No coding experience required!

### [Data Engineer in Python](/tracks/data-engineer-in-python)

Gain in-demand skills to efficiently ingest, clean, manage data, and schedule and monitor pipelines, setting you apart in the data engineering field.

### [Data Analyst in Tableau](/tracks/data-analyst-in-tableau)

Master Tableau for data analysis and develop your skills in one of the world’s most popular BI tools. No prior experience is required.

### [Data Scientist in Python](/tracks/data-scientist-in-python)

Learn data science in Python, from data manipulation to machine learning, and gain the skills needed for the Data Scientist in Python certification!

### [Machine Learning Engineer](/tracks/machine-learning-engineer)

This career track teaches you everything you need to know about machine learning engineering and MLOps.

### [Associate AI Engineer for Data Scientists](/tracks/associate-ai-engineer-for-data-scientists)

Train and fine-tune the latest AI models for production, including LLMs like Llama 3. Start your journey to becoming an AI Engineer today!

### [Python Data Fundamentals](/tracks/python-data-fundamentals)

Grow your data skills, discover how to manipulate and visualize data, and apply advanced analytics to make data-driven decisions.

### [SQL Fundamentals](/tracks/sql-fundamentals)

Master the SQL fundamentals needed for business, learn how to write SQL queries, and start analyzing your data using this powerful language.

### [Power BI Fundamentals](/tracks/power-bi-fundamentals)

Gain the essential skills you need to use Power BI. Create your own visualizations and dashboards from scratch. No prior experience required.

### [Data Literacy Professional](/tracks/data-literacy-professional)

From understanding to data storytelling - gain valuable Data Literacy Skills to tackle the toughest data challenges.

### [AI Fundamentals](/tracks/ai-fundamentals)

Discover the fundamentals of AI, learn to leverage AI effectively for work, and dive into AI models to navigate the dynamic AI landscape.

### [AWS Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)](/tracks/aws-cloud-practitioner-clf-c02)

Prepare for Amazon’s AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) by learning how to use and secure core AWS compute, database, and storage services.
